app_act_desc_letters.ha: Mkpụrụedemede. N'ebe a, anyị ga-amụta mkpụrụedemede Bekee.
app_act_desc_letters.en: Letters. Here we learn the English letters.

app_act_desc_quiz.ha: Chọta foto. A ga-akpọ aha otu ihe, mgbe ahụ pịa foto ya.
app_act_desc_quiz.en: Find the picture. The name of a thing will be said, then tap its picture.

app_act_desc_spell.ha: Ide ihe. N'ebe a, anyị ga-amụta ide okwu Bekee, mkpụrụedemede n'otu n'otu.
app_act_desc_spell.en: Writing. Here we learn to write English words, letter by letter.

app_act_pick.ha: Họrọ otu ihe ọmụmụ, ka ị nụ ihe gbasara ya.
app_act_pick.en: Pick a lesson, to hear more about it.

app_book_start.ha: Ka ị malite, pịa akwụkwọ dị n'elu a ka ị malite ịmụ ihe.
app_book_start.en: To start, tap the book up here to begin learning.

app_book_more.ha: Pịa akwụkwọ ahụ ka ị gaa n'ihu ịmụ ihe.
app_book_more.en: Tap the book to continue learning.

app_book_or.ha: Ị nwekwara ike ịpị otu ihe ọmụmụ ka ị nụkwuo maka ya.
app_book_or.en: You can also press a lesson to hear more about it.

app_board_intro.ha: Lee mkpụrụedemede niile. Ka anyị mụta ha ìgwè n'ìgwè.
app_board_intro.en: Here are all the letters. Let's learn them group by group.

app_cat_desc_animals.ha: Anụmanụ. Ihe ọmụmụ a bụ maka anụmanụ dị iche iche bi gburugburu anyị.
app_cat_desc_animals.en: Animals. This lesson is about the different animals that live around us.

app_cat_desc_body.ha: Ahụ. Ihe ọmụmụ a bụ maka akụkụ ahụ mmadụ dị iche iche.
app_cat_desc_body.en: The body. This lesson is about the different parts of the human body.

app_cat_desc_food.ha: Nri. Ihe ọmụmụ a bụ maka nri dị iche iche anyị na-eri kwa ụbọchị.
app_cat_desc_food.en: Food. This lesson is about the different foods we eat every day.

app_cat_desc_home.ha: Ihe ụlọ. Ihe ọmụmụ a bụ maka ihe anyị na-eji n'ụlọ.
app_cat_desc_home.en: Household things. This lesson is about the things used at home.

app_cat_desc_nature.ha: Okike. Ihe ọmụmụ a bụ maka ihe dị n'okike na gburugburu anyị.
app_cat_desc_nature.en: Nature. This lesson is about the things in nature and our surroundings.

app_cat_desc_vehicles.ha: Ụgbọ njem. Ihe ọmụmụ a bụ maka ụgbọala na ihe ndị ọzọ anyị na-anya.
app_cat_desc_vehicles.en: Vehicles. This lesson is about cars and the different things we ride.

app_cat_start_animals.ha: Ugbu a, anyị ga-ahụ foto anụmanụ. Anyị ga-amụta aha ha n'asụsụ Bekee.
app_cat_start_animals.en: Now we'll see pictures of animals. We'll learn their names in English.

app_cat_start_body.ha: Ugbu a, anyị ga-ahụ foto akụkụ ahụ. Anyị ga-amụta aha ha n'asụsụ Bekee.
app_cat_start_body.en: Now we'll see pictures of body parts. We'll learn their names in English.

app_cat_start_food.ha: Ugbu a, anyị ga-ahụ foto nri. Anyị ga-amụta aha ha n'asụsụ Bekee.
app_cat_start_food.en: Now we'll see pictures of food. We'll learn their names in English.

app_cat_start_home.ha: Ugbu a, anyị ga-ahụ foto ihe ụlọ. Anyị ga-amụta aha ha n'asụsụ Bekee.
app_cat_start_home.en: Now we'll see pictures of household things. We'll learn their names in English.

app_cat_start_nature.ha: Ugbu a, anyị ga-ahụ foto ihe okike. Anyị ga-amụta aha ha n'asụsụ Bekee.
app_cat_start_nature.en: Now we'll see pictures of things in nature. We'll learn their names in English.

app_cat_start_numbers.ha: Ugbu a, anyị ga-amụta ịgụ ọnụ. A ga-egosi mkpịsị aka. Gụọ mkpịsị aka ndị e weliri elu, mgbe ahụ kwuo ọnụọgụ ahụ n'asụsụ Bekee.
app_cat_start_numbers.en: Now we'll learn to count. Fingers will be shown. Count the fingers that are up, then say the number in English.

app_cat_start_vehicles.ha: Ugbu a, anyị ga-ahụ foto ụgbọ njem. Anyị ga-amụta aha ha n'asụsụ Bekee.
app_cat_start_vehicles.en: Now we'll see pictures of vehicles. We'll learn their names in English.

app_quiz_tap.ha: Pịa foto ihe a kpọrọ aha ya.
app_quiz_tap.en: Tap the picture of the thing that was named.

app_quiz_wrong.ha: Mba, ọ bụghị nke ahụ. Gee ntị ọzọ, nwaa ọzọ.
app_quiz_wrong.en: No, not that one. Listen again, try again.

app_read_good.ha: Ị mere nke ọma! Ugbu a, ị maala ịgụ ihe!
app_read_good.en: Well done! Now you can read!

app_read_intro.ha: Lee otu okwu. Anyị ga-agụ okwu a ọnụ. Mkpụrụedemede n'otu n'otu.
app_read_intro.en: Here is a word. We'll read this word together. Letter by letter.

app_read_word.ha: Ugbu a, gụọ okwu ahụ niile ọnụ, n'olu dị elu.
app_read_word.en: Now read the whole word, out loud.

app_spell_intro.ha: Ugbu a, dee ya n'asụsụ Bekee. Ụzọ abụọ dị.
app_spell_intro.en: Now write it in English. There are two ways.

app_spell_ord_1.ha: Pịa ma ọ bụ kwuo mkpụrụedemede nke mbụ.
app_spell_ord_1.en: Tap or say the first letter.

app_spell_ord_2.ha: Pịa ma ọ bụ kwuo mkpụrụedemede nke abụọ.
app_spell_ord_2.en: Tap or say the second letter.

app_spell_ord_3.ha: Pịa ma ọ bụ kwuo mkpụrụedemede nke atọ.
app_spell_ord_3.en: Tap or say the third letter.

app_spell_ord_4.ha: Pịa ma ọ bụ kwuo mkpụrụedemede nke anọ.
app_spell_ord_4.en: Tap or say the fourth letter.

app_spell_ord_5.ha: Pịa ma ọ bụ kwuo mkpụrụedemede nke ise.
app_spell_ord_5.en: Tap or say the fifth letter.

app_spell_ord_6.ha: Pịa ma ọ bụ kwuo mkpụrụedemede nke isii.
app_spell_ord_6.en: Tap or say the sixth letter.

app_spell_ord_7.ha: Pịa ma ọ bụ kwuo mkpụrụedemede nke asaa.
app_spell_ord_7.en: Tap or say the seventh letter.

app_spell_ord_8.ha: Pịa ma ọ bụ kwuo mkpụrụedemede nke asatọ.
app_spell_ord_8.en: Tap or say the eighth letter.

app_spell_ord_9.ha: Pịa ma ọ bụ kwuo mkpụrụedemede nke itoolu.
app_spell_ord_9.en: Tap or say the ninth letter.

app_spell_way_speak.en: Press Chioma and say the letter.

app_spell_way_tap.ha: Ma ọ bụ pịa mkpụrụedemede ọ bụla.

app_stage_done.ha: Ị mere nke ọma! I mechaala ìgwè a.
app_stage_done.en: Well done! You've finished this group.

app_w_menu_intro.ha: Lee ihe ọmụmụ dị iche iche. Pịa foto ọ bụla ka ịmata ihe dị n'ime ya.
app_w_menu_intro.en: Here are the different lessons. Tap any picture to find out what's in it.

app_w_spell_test.ha: Ugbu a, ule! Dee nke ọ bụla, mkpụrụedemede n'otu n'otu.
app_w_spell_test.en: Now, a test! Write each one, letter by letter.

app_z_speak.ha: Mgbe ọ bụla ịchọrọ ikwu okwu, pịa Chioma. Aga m ege ntị nke ọma!
app_z_speak.en: Whenever you want to speak, press Chioma. I'll listen carefully!

s0.ha: Ndewo! Ọ bụrụ na ị bụ nwa agbọghọ, pịa nke ọcha. Ọ bụrụ na ị bụ nwa nwoke, pịa nke uhie.
s0.en: Hello! If you are a girl, tap the white one. If you are a boy, tap the red one.

s_abc_say.ha: Pịa Chioma, mgbe ahụ kwuo mkpụrụedemede ị hụrụ.
s_abc_say.en: Press Chioma, then say the letter you see.

s_act_desc_things.ha: Ihe dị iche iche. N'ebe a, anyị ga-amụta aha ihe n'asụsụ Bekee, site na foto.
s_act_desc_things.en: Things. Here we learn the names of things in English, with pictures.

s_all_done.ha: Ị mere nke ọma! Ugbu a, ị maala mkpụrụedemede na okwu niile.
s_all_done.en: Well done! Now you know all the letters and words.

s_alone2.ha: Mmadụ nọ n'akụkụ gị. Biko, nọrọ naanị gị n'ihu kamera.
s_alone2.en: There is someone next to you. Please sit alone in front of the camera.

s_back_m.ha: Ka ị laghachi azụ, pịa ụzọ a.

s_back_f.ha: Ka ị laghachi azụ, pịa ụzọ a.

s_cat_desc_actions.ha: Omume. Ihe ọmụmụ a bụ maka ihe anyị na-eme kwa ụbọchị. Dịka iri nri, ịṅụ mmiri, ịgba ọsọ na igwu egwu.
s_cat_desc_actions.en: Actions. This lesson is about the things we do every day. Like eating, drinking, running and playing.

s_cat_desc_clothing.ha: Uwe. Ihe ọmụmụ a bụ maka uwe anyị na-eyi.
s_cat_desc_clothing.en: Clothing. This lesson is about the clothes we wear.

s_cat_desc_people.ha: Ndị mmadụ. Ihe ọmụmụ a bụ maka ndị mmadụ nọ gburugburu anyị. Mama, papa, ụmụaka na ndị nkuzi.
s_cat_desc_people.en: People. This lesson is about the people around us. Mum, dad, children and teachers.

s_cat_desc_school.ha: Ụlọ akwụkwọ. Ihe ọmụmụ a bụ maka ihe anyị na-eji n'ụlọ akwụkwọ.
s_cat_desc_school.en: School. This lesson is about the things we use at school.

s_cat_start_actions.ha: Ugbu a, anyị ga-ahụ foto omume. Anyị ga-amụta aha ha n'asụsụ Bekee.
s_cat_start_actions.en: Now we'll see pictures of actions. We'll learn their names in English.

s_cat_start_clothing.ha: Ugbu a, anyị ga-ahụ foto uwe. Anyị ga-amụta aha ha n'asụsụ Bekee.
s_cat_start_clothing.en: Now we'll see pictures of clothes. We'll learn their names in English.

s_cat_start_people.ha: Ugbu a, anyị ga-ahụ foto ndị mmadụ. Anyị ga-amụta aha ha n'asụsụ Bekee.
s_cat_start_people.en: Now we'll see pictures of people. We'll learn their names in English.

s_cat_start_school.ha: Ugbu a, anyị ga-ahụ foto ihe ụlọ akwụkwọ. Anyị ga-amụta aha ha n'asụsụ Bekee.
s_cat_start_school.en: Now we'll see pictures of school things. We'll learn their names in English.

s_ear.ha: Ka ị nụ ya ọzọ, pịa ntị a.
s_ear.en: To hear it again, press this ear.

s_go.ha: Ugbu a, pịa Chioma ka anyị malite.
s_go.en: Now press Chioma and we'll start.

s_k_intro2.ha: Ịgụ ihe. N'ebe a, anyị ga-agụ okwu, mkpụrụedemede n'otu n'otu, mgbe ahụ okwu ahụ niile ọnụ.
s_k_intro2.en: Reading. Here we read words, letter by letter, then all at once.

s_k_lesson.ha: Ugbu a, anyị ga-agụ aha ihe ndị a n'asụsụ Bekee.
s_k_lesson.en: Now we'll read the names of these things in English.

s_k_test.ha: Ugbu a, anyị ga-eme obere ule maka okwu ị mụtara. A ga-egosi gị otu okwu, gụọ ya niile ọnụ.
s_k_test.en: Now we'll do a small test on the words you learned. A word will be shown, and you read it whole.

s_kd_k3.ha: Okwu dị mkpụmkpụ. N'ebe a, anyị ga-agụ okwu dị mkpụmkpụ, nwere mkpụrụedemede atọ.
s_kd_k3.en: Short words. Here we read short, three-letter words.

s_kd_k45.ha: Okwu dị n'etiti. N'ebe a, anyị ga-agụ okwu nwere mkpụrụedemede anọ na ise.
s_kd_k45.en: Medium words. Here we read four- and five-letter words.

s_kd_klong.ha: Okwu dị ogologo. N'ebe a, anyị ga-agụ okwu dị ogologo.
s_kd_klong.en: Long words. Here we read long words.

s_kd_knum.ha: Ọnụọgụ. N'ebe a, anyị ga-agụ aha ọnụọgụ n'asụsụ Bekee.
s_kd_knum.en: Numbers. Here we read the names of numbers in English.

s_l_check.ha: Ugbu a, anyị ga-eme obere ule, ka anyị mara na ị ghọtara mkpụrụedemede ị mụtara.
s_l_check.en: Now we'll do a small test, to make sure you understood the letters you learned.

s_l_final1.ha: Nnukwu ule. Kwuo mkpụrụedemede niile, otu n'otu.
s_l_final1.en: The big test. Say all the letters, one after another.

s_l_final2.ha: Ule ikpeazụ. A ga-agwakọta mkpụrụedemede ma gosi gị ha. Kwuo ha niile.
s_l_final2.en: The last test. The letters will be shown mixed up; say them all.

s_l_look.ha: Lee mkpụrụedemede anọ. Gee ntị, leba anya.
s_l_look.en: Here are four letters. Listen and look.

s_l_new2.ha: Ugbu a, ị ga-ahụ mkpụrụedemede ọhụrụ abụọ ị ga-amụta. Nke a bụ ọkwa ọhụrụ, nke dị ezigbo mkpa.
s_l_new2.en: Now you'll see two new letters to learn. This is a new stage, a very important one.

s_l_new4.ha: Ugbu a, ị ga-ahụ mkpụrụedemede ọhụrụ anọ ị ga-amụta. Nke a bụ ọkwa ọhụrụ, nke dị ezigbo mkpa.
s_l_new4.en: Now you'll see four new letters to learn. This is a new stage, a very important one.

s_l_recall.ha: Ugbu a, kwuo ya n'onwe gị.

s_laila2.ha: Aha m bụ Chioma. Abụ m enyi gị n'ọmụmụ ihe. Ugbu a, pịa isi m ka anyị malite.
s_laila2.en: My name is Chioma. I'm your learning friend. Now press my head and we'll start.

s_leave.ha: Anyị ga-akwụsị ọmụmụ ihe a. Ọ bụrụ na i mechaala, pịa Chioma. Ma ọ bụghị ya, pịa bọọdụ ojii.
s_leave.en: The session will end. If you are done, press Chioma. If not, press the black slate.

s_loading.ha: Biko, chere ntakịrị. A na-edozi ihe niile.
s_loading.en: Please wait a little. Everything is getting ready.

s_n_big.ha: Ugbu a, nnukwu ule! Anyị ga-anwale ọnụọgụ niile ị mụtara, ka anyị mara na ị ma ha. A ga-egosi gị otu ọnụọgụ, a ga-akpọ aha ya n'asụsụ Igbo, mgbe ahụ gị onwe gị ga-akpọ aha ya n'asụsụ Bekee. Ọ bụrụ na i chefuola aha ya n'asụsụ Bekee,
s_n_big.en: Now the big test! We'll test all the numbers you learned, to make sure you know them. A number will be shown, its name said in Igbo, and you say its name in English. If you've forgotten its English name,

s_n_focus5.ha: Ugbu a, anyị ga-amụgharị ndị siiri gị ike, ya na ụfọdụ ndị ị maara, ka anyị mekwuo ha ọzọ.
s_n_focus5.en: Now we'll learn again the ones you struggled with, together with a few you know, for extra practice.

s_n_hundreds.ha: Ugbu a, narị: narị abụọ, narị atọ, ruo narị itoolu, mgbe ahụ puku.
s_n_hundreds.en: Now the hundreds: two hundred, three hundred, up to nine hundred, then a thousand.

s_n_intro.ha: N'ebe a, anyị ga-amụta ọnụọgụ. Nke mbụ, anyị ga-eji mkpịsị aka gụọ ọnụ, site na otu ruo iri. Mgbe ahụ, anyị ga-amụta akara ọnụọgụ.
s_n_intro.en: Here we learn numbers. First we count on our fingers, one to ten. Then we learn the number signs.

s_n_palms.ha: Lee aka. Gụọ mkpịsị aka ndị e weliri elu.
s_n_palms.en: Here is a hand. Count the fingers that are up.

s_n_sym2.ha: Ugbu a, akara ọnụọgụ site na iri na otu ruo iri abụọ.
s_n_sym2.en: Now the number signs from eleven to twenty.

s_n_symbols.ha: Ugbu a, anyị ga-amụta akara ọnụọgụ ndị ị mụtara, site na otu ruo iri.
s_n_symbols.en: Now we'll learn the signs of the numbers you learned, one to ten.

s_n_tens.ha: Ugbu a, anyị ga-amụta ọnụọgụ ndị buru ibu: iri atọ, iri anọ, iri ise, ruo narị.
s_n_tens.en: Now we'll learn the big numbers: thirty, forty, fifty, up to a hundred.

s_o_again2.ha: Gee ntị ọzọ. N'asụsụ Bekee, ọ bụ:
s_o_again2.en: Listen again. In English, it is:

s_o_allright.ha: Ị zara ha niile nke ọma! Ugbu a, anyị ga-aga n'ihu.
s_o_allright.en: You got them all right! Now we go on.

s_o_focus_m.ha: Foto ndị ị ga-ahụ ugbu a bụ ndị siiri gị ike. Anyị ga-amụgharị ha.
s_o_focus_m.en: The pictures you'll see now are the ones you struggled with. We'll learn them again.

s_o_focus_f.ha: Foto ndị ị ga-ahụ ugbu a bụ ndị siiri gị ike. Anyị ga-amụgharị ha.
s_o_focus_f.en: The pictures you'll see now are the ones you struggled with. We'll learn them again.

s_o_focus.en: The pictures you'll see now are the ones you struggled with. We'll learn them again.

s_o_look.ha: Lee foto. Gee ntị, leba anya.
s_o_look.en: Here are three pictures. Listen and look.

s_o_miss.ha: Nke ahụ ezighi ezi. Ka anyị gaa n'ihu.
s_o_miss.en: That one wasn't right. Let's go on.

s_o_new3.ha: Ugbu a, lee foto ise ọzọ.
s_o_new3.en: Now here are five more pictures.

s_o_next.ha: Ugbu a, ka anyị gaa na nke ọzọ.

s_o_retake.ha: Ụfọdụ ezighi ezi. Anyị ga-amụgharị ha, mgbe ahụ anyị ga-eme ule ahụ ọzọ.
s_o_retake.en: Some weren't right. We'll learn them again, then take the test again.

s_o_right.ha: Lee ndị ị zara nke ọma:
s_o_right.en: Here are the ones you got right:

s_o_test2.ha: Ugbu a, anyị ga-eme obere ule, ka anyị mara na ị ma ha. A ga-egosi gị otu foto, a ga-akpọ aha ya n'asụsụ Igbo, mgbe ahụ gị onwe gị ga-akpọ aha ya n'asụsụ Bekee. Ọ bụrụ na i chefuola aha ya n'asụsụ Bekee,
s_o_test2.en: Now we'll do a small test, to make sure you know them. A picture will be shown, its name said in Igbo, and you say its name in English. If you've forgotten its English name,

s_o_three.ha: Nke ahụ siri ike. Ugbu a, ka anyị gaa na nke ọzọ.
s_o_three.en: That one is hard. Now, on to the next.

s_o_turn.ha: Ọ bụ oge gị. Pịa Chioma, kpọọ aha ya n'asụsụ Bekee.
s_o_turn.en: Your turn. Press Chioma and say its name in English.

s_o_wrong.ha: Ndị a kwa, anyị ga-amụgharị ha:

s_p1_m.ha: Anyị ga-ese vidiyo gị ka ị na-akpọ aha gị. Dịka ọmụmaatụ, ọ bụrụ na aha gị bụ Ebuka, sị: Aha m bụ Ebuka.
s_p1_m.en: We will take a video of you saying your name. For example, if your name is Ebuka, say: Aha m bụ Ebuka.

s_p1_f.ha: Anyị ga-ese vidiyo gị ka ị na-akpọ aha gị. Dịka ọmụmaatụ, ọ bụrụ na aha gị bụ Chichi, sị: Aha m bụ Chichi.
s_p1_f.en: We will take a video of you saying your name. For example, if your name is Ebuka, say: Aha m bụ Ebuka.

s_p2.ha: Lee nwa nwoke aha ya bụ Ebuka. Ọ na-akpọ aha ya.
s_p2.en: Here is the boy Ebuka / the girl Chichi, saying the name.

s_p2_f.ha: Lee nwa agbọghọ aha ya bụ Chichi. Ọ na-akpọ aha ya.
s_p2_f.en: Here is the boy Ebuka / the girl Chichi, saying the name.

s_p3.ha: Ugbu a, ọ bụ oge gị. Pịa Chioma, mgbe ahụ gwa anyị aha gị.
s_p3.en: Now you: press Chioma, then say your name.

s_perm.ha: Anyị chọrọ kamera na maikrofon ka ihe a rụọ ọrụ. Pịa 'Allow'.
s_perm.en: We need the camera and the microphone for this to work. Tap 'Allow'.

s_perm_no.ha: E nyeghị ikike. Nwaa ọzọ, pịa 'Allow'.
s_perm_no.en: Permission was not given. Try again and tap 'Allow'.

s_q_again.ha: Ugbu a, ka anyị nwaa ọzọ, were ndị ọhụrụ. Gee ntị nke ọma.
s_q_again.en: Now let's play again, with new ones. Listen carefully.

s_qd_q4.ha: Foto anọ. A ga-egosi gị foto anọ, a ga-akpọ aha otu n'ime ha n'asụsụ Bekee, mgbe ahụ pịa ya.
s_qd_q4.en: Four pictures. You'll see four pictures, one will be named in English, and you tap it.

s_qd_qnum.ha: Ọnụọgụ. A ga-akpọ otu ọnụọgụ n'asụsụ Bekee, mgbe ahụ pịa akara ya.
s_qd_qnum.en: Numbers. A number will be said in English, and you tap its sign.

s_qn_tap.en: Tap the sign of the number that was said.

s_r_intro2.ha: N'ebe a, anyị ga-amụta ide aha ihe n'asụsụ Bekee, mkpụrụedemede n'otu n'otu. A ga-egosi gị foto, mgbe ahụ dee aha ya.
s_r_intro2.en: Here we learn to write the names of things in English, letter by letter. A picture will be shown, and you write its name.

s_r_turn.ha: Ọ bụ oge gị. Họrọ ihe ọmụmụ.

s_rd_r3.ha: Mkpụrụedemede atọ. N'ebe a, anyị ga-ede okwu nwere mkpụrụedemede atọ, n'otu n'otu.
s_rd_r3.en: Three letters. Here we write three-letter words, letter by letter.

s_rd_r4.ha: Mkpụrụedemede anọ. N'ebe a, anyị ga-ede okwu nwere mkpụrụedemede anọ, n'otu n'otu.
s_rd_r4.en: Four letters. Here we write four-letter words, letter by letter.

s_rd_r5.ha: Mkpụrụedemede ise. N'ebe a, anyị ga-ede okwu nwere mkpụrụedemede ise, n'otu n'otu.
s_rd_r5.en: Five letters. Here we write five-letter words, letter by letter.

s_rd_rlong.ha: Okwu dị ogologo. N'ebe a, anyị ga-ede okwu dị ogologo, mkpụrụedemede n'otu n'otu.
s_rd_rlong.en: Long words. Here we write long words, letter by letter.

s_rd_rnum.ha: Ọnụọgụ. N'ebe a, anyị ga-ede aha ọnụọgụ n'asụsụ Bekee, mkpụrụedemede n'otu n'otu.
s_rd_rnum.en: Numbers. Here we write the names of numbers in English, letter by letter.

s_retry_face.ha: Anaghị m ahụ gị nke ọma. Biko, ka anyị nwaa ọzọ.
s_retry_face.en: I can't see you well. Please, let's try again.

s_retry_name.ha: Anụghị m aha gị nke ọma. Biko, ka anyị nwaa ọzọ.
s_retry_name.en: I couldn't hear you say your name. Please, let's try again.

s_retry_laila.ha: Pịa Chioma ka ị nwaa ọzọ.

s_retry_door.ha: Ma ọ bụ pịa ụzọ a ka ị malitegharịa.
s_retry_door.en: Or click this door to go back and start again.

sx_intro.ha: Ọmụmaatụ! Lee anya, gee ntị ka e si eme ya.
sx_intro.en: Example! Watch and listen to how it's done.

sx_k_letters.ha: Aga m agụ mkpụrụedemede ndị a, otu n'otu. Gee ntị.
sx_k_letters.en: I will read the letters, one by one. Listen.

sx_now.ha: Ọ bụ oge gị. Nwaa ya.

s_w_name.ha: Aha m bụ Chioma. Abụ m enyi gị n'ọmụmụ ihe.
s_w_name.en: My name is Chioma. I am your learning friend.

s_w_together.en: Together we are going to learn English.

s_w_have.ha: Enwere m ihe ọmụmụ ndị mara mma nke ukwuu.

s_w_l1.en: We will learn the English alphabet.

s_w_l2.ha: Anyị ga-amụta ịgụ na ide ihe n'asụsụ Bekee.
s_w_l2.en: We will learn to read and write in English.

s_w_l4.ha: Anyị ga-amụta aha ihe dịka anụmanụ na nri, n'asụsụ Bekee.
s_w_l4.en: We will learn the names of things like animals and foods, in English.

s_w_more.ha: Na ọtụtụ ihe ọzọ na-atọ ụtọ.

s_w_talk.ha: Ị ga-enwe ike ịgwa m okwu. Aga m anọnyere gị.
s_w_talk.en: You will be able to speak to me and I will be with you.

s_b_glad.ha: Obi dị m ụtọ ịhụ gị.
s_b_glad.en: I am happy to see you.

s_b_cont.ha: Ugbu a, ka anyị gaa n'ihu site n'ebe anyị kwụsịrị.
s_b_cont.en: Now let us continue from where we stopped.

sx_do_say.ha: Lee ihe ị ga-eme ka i kwuo ya n'asụsụ Bekee. Ị ga-apị Chioma, mgbe ahụ ị ga-asị:
sx_do_say.en: Here is what you will do to say it in English. You will press Chioma, then you will say:

sx_do_read.ha: Lee ihe ị ga-eme ka ị gụọ ya n'asụsụ Bekee. Ị ga-apị Chioma, mgbe ahụ ị ga-agụ okwu a:
sx_do_read.en: Here is what you will do to read it in English. You will press Chioma, then you will read the word:

sx_do_spell.ha: Lee ihe ị ga-eme ka i dee ya n'asụsụ Bekee. Ị ga-apị Chioma, mgbe ahụ ị ga-ekwu mkpụrụedemede ndị a:
sx_do_spell.en: Here is what you will do to write it in English. You will press Chioma, then you will say the letters:

sx_do_find.ha: Lee ihe ị ga-eme. Gee ntị, mgbe ahụ pịa foto a kpọrọ aha ya.
sx_do_find.en: Here is what you will do. Listen, then press the picture that was named.

sx_do_findnum.ha: Lee ihe ị ga-eme. Gee ntị, mgbe ahụ pịa akara ọnụọgụ a kpọrọ.
sx_do_findnum.en: Here is what you will do. Listen, then press the number that was named.

s_q_start.ha: Ugbu a, a ga-egosi gị foto anọ. Gee ntị n'aha a kpọrọ n'asụsụ Bekee, mgbe ahụ pịa ya.
s_q_start.en: Now you will be shown four pictures. Listen for the name said in English, then press it.

s_qn_start.ha: Ugbu a, a ga-egosi gị akara ọnụọgụ. Gee ntị n'ọnụọgụ a kpọrọ n'asụsụ Bekee, mgbe ahụ pịa ya.
s_qn_start.en: Now you will be shown numbers. Listen for the one said in English, then press it.

sx_r_plan.ha: Anyị ga-ekwu mkpụrụedemede ndị a, otu n'otu. Ụzọ abụọ dị.
sx_r_plan.en: We will say the letters one after another. There are two ways.

sx_r_v1.ha: Mkpụrụedemede nke mbụ, aga m eji olu m kwuo ya.
sx_r_v1.en: The first letter, I will say with my voice.

sx_r_v2.ha: Mkpụrụedemede nke abụọ kwa, aga m eji olu m kwuo ya.
sx_r_v2.en: The second letter too, I will say with my voice.

sx_r_kb.ha: Mkpụrụedemede ikpeazụ, aga m apị ya na bọọdụ.
sx_r_kb.en: And the last letter, I will press it on the board.

s_pop_intro.ha: Lee bọlụn ndị nwere mkpụrụedemede. Jiri mkpịsị aka gị pịa bọlụn, ọ ga-agbawa.
s_pop_intro.en: Here are balloons with letters. Press a balloon with your finger and it bursts.

s_pop_done.ha: Ị mere nke ọma, anyị emechaala egwuregwu a!
s_pop_done.en: Well done, we've finished the game!

s_pop_task.ha: Chọta mkpụrụedemede mbụ nke Bekee, gbawaa ya. Mgbe ahụ, nke na-esote ya, n'usoro.
s_pop_task.en: Find the first letter of English and pop it. Then the letter after it, in order.

s_gate_calm.ha: Echegbula onwe gị. Ka anyị buru ụzọ mụta ha.
s_gate_calm.en: Don't worry. Let us learn them first.

s_gate_play.en: We are going to play a little game.

s_gate_first.ha: Anyị chọrọ ịma na ị ma mkpụrụedemede Bekee, dịka
s_gate_first.en: We want to make sure you know the English letters, like

s_gate_yes.ha: Ọ bụrụ na ị ma ha, pịa Chioma ka ị malite.
s_gate_yes.en: If you know them, tap Chioma to begin.

s_gate_no.ha: Ọ bụrụ na ị maghị ha, ọ dịghị nsogbu, anyị ga-amụkọ ha ọnụ. Pịa bọọdụ ojii ka ị malite ịmụ ihe.
s_gate_no.en: If you don't, no problem, we will learn them together. Tap the black slate to begin learning.

s_g_fish_how.ha: Jide azụ na-ebu ihe m kwuru.
s_g_fish_how.en: Catch the fish carrying the thing I say.

s_g_drum_how.ha: Lee foto a. Pịa Chioma, kwuo aha ya n'asụsụ Bekee, m ga-akụ ogene!
s_g_drum_how.en: Look at this picture. Tap Chioma, say its name in English, and I will ring the ogene!

s_g_market_how.ha: Ndị ahịa abịala! Mee ngwa nye onye ọ bụla ihe ọ chọrọ.
s_g_market_how.en: The shoppers are here! Quickly give each one what they ask for.

s_g_canoes_how.ha: Gụọ okwu dị n'ụgbọala ọ bụla, wee pịa nke dabara na foto ahụ. Ọ ga-apụ n'ogige ahụ!
s_g_canoes_how.en: Read the word on each lorry, then tap the one that matches the picture. It will drive out of the park!

s_g_pots_how.ha: Ka anyị kee ọla aka! Pịa mkpụrụ aka nwere mkpụrụedemede okwu ahụ otu otu.
s_g_pots_how.en: Let's string a coral necklace! Tap the beads with the word's letters one after another.

s_g_house_how.ha: Ka anyị wuo ụlọ ahụ tupu oge agwụ! Pịa Chioma ma kwuo mkpụrụedemede okwu ahụ otu otu. Mkpụrụedemede ọ bụla bụ otu brik.
s_g_house_how.en: Let's build the house before time runs out! Tap Chioma and say the word's letters one by one. Every letter is a brick.

s_g_learn.ha: Ọ dịghị nsogbu! Ka anyị malite ịmụkọ ihe ọnụ. Pịa Chioma ka ị gaa n'ihu.
s_g_learn.en: No problem! Let's start learning together. Tap Chioma to continue.

s_g_go.ha: Pịa Chioma ka ị gaa n'ihu.

s_g_durbar_how.ha: Kwuo mkpụrụedemede dị na ọkọlọtọ ahụ, ọgbọ ahụ ga-ekele Obi!
s_g_durbar_how.en: Say the letter on the banner, and the age-grade will greet the Obi!

s_g_durbar_eg1.ha: Nke a bụ ka egwuregwu a si aga: kwuo mkpụrụedemede ị hụrụ na ọkọlọtọ ahụ, ka obi dị Obi ụtọ.
s_g_durbar_eg1.en: Here is how the game works: say the letter you see on the banner, so the Obi is happy.

s_g_durbar_ready.ha: Ugbu a, pịa Chioma ka anyị malite.
s_g_durbar_ready.en: Now press Chioma and we'll start.

s_g_dillali_how.ha: Kwuo aha ihe a n'asụsụ Bekee, onye ahịa ga-ere ya!
s_g_dillali_how.en: Say this thing's name in English, and the trader will sell it!

s_g_shayi_how.ha: Kwuo ihe ị chọrọ n'asụsụ Bekee, onye na-ere ya ga-enye gị ya!
s_g_shayi_how.en: Say what you want in English, and the seller will give it to you!

s_g_gyada_how.ha: Pịa ìgwè nwere ọnụ ọgụgụ akpa garri m kwuru.
s_g_gyada_how.en: Tap the stack with as many garri sacks as the number I say.

s_g_shanu_how.ha: Pịa nke ọnụ ahịa ya dabara na ihe m kwuru.
s_g_shanu_how.en: Tap the one whose price matches what I say.

s_g_garke_how.ha: Gụọ ehi ndị dị n'ogige ahụ, wee kwuo ole ha dị n'asụsụ Bekee.
s_g_garke_how.en: Count the cows in the pen and say how many in English.

s_g_garke_eg1.ha: Nke a bụ ka egwuregwu a si aga: gụọ ehi ndị dị n'ogige ahụ, wee kwuo ole ha dị n'asụsụ Bekee.
s_g_garke_eg1.en: Here is how the game works: count the cows in the pen, then say how many in English.

s_g_suya_how.ha: Kwuo ego dị gị n'aka n'asụsụ Bekee, wee kwụọ onye na-ere ọka ụgwọ.
s_g_suya_how.en: Say the money in your hand in English, and pay the corn seller.

s_g_allo_how.ha: Gụọ okwu dị na mgbidi ahụ n'olu dara ụda, onye ese ga-eme ya uli.
s_g_allo_how.en: Read the word on the wall out loud, and the painter will turn it into uli.

s_g_jirgi_how.ha: Gụọ okwu dị n'ụgbọ mmiri ahụ n'olu dara ụda, ọ ga-abịa n'ọnụ mmiri.
s_g_jirgi_how.en: Read the word on the boat out loud, and it will come to the bank.

s_g_marubuci_how.ha: Kwuo mkpụrụedemede okwu ahụ otu otu, ma ọ bụ pịa ha na kiibọọdụ, onye na-ede akwụkwọ ozi ga-ede ha.
s_g_marubuci_how.en: Say the letters of the word one by one, or press them on the keyboard, and the letter writer will write them.

s_g_ruwa_how.ha: Gụọ okwu dị n'igwe ojii ahụ n'olu dara ụda, mmiri ozuzo ga-ezo n'ubi.
s_g_ruwa_how.en: Read the word on the cloud out loud, and the rain will fall on the farm.

s_g_rini_how.ha: Kwuo mkpụrụedemede okwu ahụ otu otu, ma ọ bụ pịa ha na kiibọọdụ, a ga-esiji ha n'akwa ahụ.
s_g_rini_how.en: Say the letters of the word one by one, or press them on the keyboard, and they will be dyed into the cloth.

s_l_game.ha: Ugbu a, ka anyị jiri mkpụrụedemede ị mụtara gwuo egwuregwu!
s_l_game.en: Now let's play a game with the letters you've learned!

s_pop_again.ha: Ọ fọrọ obere! Ka anyị nwaa ọzọ.
s_pop_again.en: You were close! Let's try once more.

s_game_open.ha: Ugbu a, ị nwere ike igwu egwuregwu a mgbe ọ bụla ịchọrọ, site na peeji mbụ.
s_game_open.en: Now you can play this game whenever you like, from the home page.

s_z_got_3_50.ha: Ị mere nke ọma! Ị nwetala kpakpando atọ na ọlaedo iri ise.
s_z_got_3_50.en: Well done! You earned three stars and 50 gold.

s_z_got_3_100.ha: Ị mere nke ọma! Ị nwetala kpakpando atọ na ọlaedo otu narị.
s_z_got_3_100.en: Well done! You earned three stars and 100 gold.

s_z_got_3_150.ha: Ị mere nke ọma! Ị nwetala kpakpando atọ na ọlaedo otu narị na iri ise.
s_z_got_3_150.en: Well done! You earned three stars and 150 gold.

s_z_got_3_200.ha: Ị mere nke ọma! Ị nwetala kpakpando atọ na ọlaedo narị abụọ.
s_z_got_3_200.en: Well done! You earned three stars and 200 gold.

s_z_got_4_50.ha: Ị mere nke ọma! Ị nwetala kpakpando anọ na ọlaedo iri ise.
s_z_got_4_50.en: Well done! You earned four stars and 50 gold.

s_z_got_4_100.ha: Ị mere nke ọma! Ị nwetala kpakpando anọ na ọlaedo otu narị.
s_z_got_4_100.en: Well done! You earned four stars and 100 gold.

s_z_got_4_150.ha: Ị mere nke ọma! Ị nwetala kpakpando anọ na ọlaedo otu narị na iri ise.
s_z_got_4_150.en: Well done! You earned four stars and 150 gold.

s_z_got_4_200.ha: Ị mere nke ọma! Ị nwetala kpakpando anọ na ọlaedo narị abụọ.
s_z_got_4_200.en: Well done! You earned four stars and 200 gold.

s_z_now_fada.ha: Ugbu a, ị bụzi Onye Obi!
s_z_now_fada.en: Now you are a Onye Obi!

s_z_now_malami.ha: Ugbu a, ị bụzi Onye Nkuzi!
s_z_now_malami.en: Now you are a Onye Nkuzi!

s_z_now_dansarki.ha: Ugbu a, ị bụzi Nwa Eze!
s_z_now_dansarki.en: Now you are a Nwa Eze!

s_z_now_magaji.ha: Ugbu a, ị bụzi Onye Nketa!
s_z_now_magaji.en: Now you are a Onye Nketa!

s_z_effort.ha: Mgbalị gị ewetala gị n'ọkwa ọhụrụ!
s_z_effort.en: Your effort has brought you to a new level!

s_z_bag1.en: Your first bag of gold is full!

s_z_bag2.ha: Akpa ọlaedo gị nke abụọ ejupụtala!
s_z_bag2.en: Your second bag of gold is full!

s_z_bag3.ha: Akpa ọlaedo gị nke atọ ejupụtala!
s_z_bag3.en: Your third bag of gold is full!

s_z_bag4.ha: Akpa ọlaedo gị nke anọ ejupụtala!
s_z_bag4.en: Your fourth bag of gold is full!

s_z_bag5.ha: Akpa ọlaedo gị nke ise ejupụtala!
s_z_bag5.en: Your fifth bag of gold is full!

s_z_gold_12000.ha: Ọlaedo gị eruola puku iri na abụọ.

s_z_gold_16000.ha: Ọlaedo gị eruola puku iri na isii.

s_z_first.ha: Nke a bụ ọkwa mbụ. Ọkwa anọ ọzọ dị n'ihu.
s_z_first.en: This is the first level. There are four more levels ahead.

s_z_keep_first.ha: Nọgide na-agba mbọ, ruo mgbe ị ghọrọ Eze!
s_z_keep_first.en: Keep trying, until you become an Eze!

s_z_keep.en: Keep up the effort like this!

s_z_top.ha: Nke a bụ ọkwa kachasị elu!
s_z_top.en: This is the highest level of all!
